Avro Phonetic Autocorrect dictionary
=====================================

Source: Avro Keyboard by OmicronLab (https://github.com/omicronlab/Avro-Keyboard),
file "Keyboard and Spell checker/autodict.dct" in that repository.
Copyright (C) OmicronLab. All Rights Reserved.

License: Mozilla Public License Version 1.1 (MPL-1.1).
The complete license is included as MPL-1.1.txt.
The covered data is distributed locally in autodict.dct (pristine upstream
copy) and autodict.js (generated bridge). This matches how the extension
already vendors the Avro phonetic engine; see AVRO-NOTICE.txt.

Local processing, 2026-10-12:
- Copied autodict.dct unchanged into this directory.
- Generated autodict.js with scripts/autodict.cjs (run via `npm run autodict`):
  kept only Latin-to-Latin pairs that differ, dropping backtick pairs
  (upstream uses ` to break conjuncts; Shobdo reserves ` as the
  keep-English escape), all-caps keys (returned unchanged as acronyms),
  and no-ops that parse identically. Result: 3720 entries in a sorted Map.
  No phonetic rules or correction targets were changed.
- engine.js consults this map for whole Latin words; six explicit local
  aliases (acho, tomar, bhalo, valo, sona, sonar) take precedence and agree
  with the dictionary where they overlap.

MPL obligations: retain this notice and the copyright header when
redistributing; modifications to the covered files stay under MPL-1.1.
Shobdo's own wrapper code remains under its own license.
